subject: Mathematics

source.topic: This is where people live: Numeracy
source.subtopic: Symmetry: pegboard block houses symmetrical on both sides

show.line: Look at this house. One window here, one window there. Both sides are the same!

rounds.prompt: Which house is the same on both sides?
Half the house is missing! Which half makes both sides the same?
Look at the rondavel. Is it the same on both sides? Say yes or no.
Same on both sides, or not? Put each building in its group.
Which building needs another window to match?
rounds.praise: Yes! Add a window to make it match.

hints: Draw a line down the middle. Do both sides match?
Count the windows on each side.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will build a house on the pegboard.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Two windows on this side, and none on that side. It matches!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two windows here means two windows there.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Two windows this side. Put two on that side too!

parent_line: Can build or finish a house so both sides match.
